page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-4 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on dedicated x86_64 processor cores. The system provisions 4 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 15.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation ratio of 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. This balanced resource pairing targets standardized cloud computing tasks requiring consistent processing capacity without hardware oversubscription.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, featuring zero GPUs. Operating system configurations and persistent file storage rely entirely on external network-attached volumes. Network connectivity provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating Cloud NAT or reserved external routing for direct public internet communication.

In qualitative terms, the dedicated compute allocation provides predictable execution efficiency for steady-state services. The balanced compute-to-memory profile makes the c4d-standard-4 well suited for mid-tier application hosting, continuous integration runners, lightweight relational databases, containerized microservices, and general backend web serving.
